title: Fullstack PostgreSQL + Prisma + Next.js Capstone
description: Build an end-to-end production web application featuring Next.js 15, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Server Actions, and authentication.

data.text: In this comprehensive capstone lesson, we consolidate everything we've learned into a complete, production-grade fullstack web application. We'll design a project management system connecting Next.js 15 App Router, Neon/PostgreSQL, Prisma Client, Server Actions, and optimistic UI updates.

data.caption: Fullstack Architecture Flow
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[React Client Component] -->|Form Submit / Server Action| B[Next.js Server Action]
    B -->|Zod Validation| C[Validate Inputs]
    C -->|prisma.project.create()| D[(Neon PostgreSQL)]
    D -->|Transaction Commit| B
    B -->|revalidatePath('/projects')| E[Next.js Cache Revalidation]
    E -->|Stream Updated RSC| A

data.title: Project Management Schema
data.content: Demonstrates enums, 1-N relations, indexes, and cascade behavior.
data.code:
datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

enum Priority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
  URGENT
}

model Project {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  title       String   @db.VarChar(150)
  description String?  @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz
  tasks       Task[]

  @@map("projects")
}

model Task {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  title       String   @db.VarChar(200)
  isCompleted Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_completed")
  priority    Priority @default(MEDIUM)
  projectId   String   @map("project_id") @db.Uuid
  project     Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  @@index([projectId])
  @@index([isCompleted])
  @@map("tasks")
}

data.title: Capstone Summary
points: We configured a multi-table relational schema with enums, indexes, and cascades.
We built a robust Server Action with Zod validation and cache revalidation.
We queried data directly inside Next.js Server Components with complete type safety and zero client JS.
You now possess the foundational knowledge to build enterprise-grade fullstack web applications with Prisma and PostgreSQL.
